notes:
Changes since v0.2.145

- Blocks shows a live length line and displays millimeters for width only. Right-click curve nodes trace a rounder arc while drawing.
- Ask Stitchfits opens in a movable chat bubble with an animated needle. Press Enter to submit. Foam troubleshooting uses the selected object or the open wizard's error and asks a follow-up when needed.
- The 3D Foam Puff wizard sets up cover spacing, end caps and an optional placement break for compatible editable satin objects and lettering.
- Thread View hides imported travel verified against a matching PES or PEC. Original machine stitch commands are kept for export.
- Adds design tabs, a thumbnail library and print preview for one-page or actual-size tiled output, plus linear Tatami gradients, artwork import and lettering improvements.

Save your designs before updating. Test foam coverage and the machine pause on scrap before sewing a finished item.
